links.outcome: LLM adherence to 2025 ASRA antithrombotic hold/resumption guidelines in vignettes
links.effect: Concordance 64% ChatGPT vs 62% Gemini; dangerous errors 20% ChatGPT and 12% Gemini; ChatGPT omitted time in 16%; Gemini conservative errors 22%.
links.quote: Both models produced potentially dangerous recommendations in 12-20% of scenarios.

links.outcome: Variability of LLM responses across repeated queries by different users
links.effect: Response variability between users was statistically significant only for Gemini (chi-square test of homogeneity).
links.quote: Variability of responses between users was determined via a chi-square test of homogeneity and was found to be statistically significant only for Gemini.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the clinical accuracy and safety error profiles of two LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) using 25 standardized clinical vignettes against regional anesthesia guidelines.
